title: Wintersbite
wikitext:
'''Wintersbite''' is a rare [[Herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (195).

==Source==
Wintersbite can only be found in the [[Alterac Mountains]] on [[Eastern Kingdoms]], (''not to be confused with [[Alterac Valley]]'') specifically in the [[Ruins of Alterac]] region. A [[skill]] level of 195 in [[Herbalism]] is required to gather this [[herbs|herb]]. It's a grind to harvest, but the rewards are plentiful. Wintersbite can be a lucrative selling item in the [[Auction House]] because of its rarity and somewhat painstaking and time consuming collection-effort.

===Pickable zones===
*[[Alterac Mountains]] 100%
